'''Salaktori Anchorage'''<ref name="TERC" /> was a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]<ref name="TMA" /> located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It housed the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] [[Bounty Hunters' Guild complex|headquarters]].<ref name="TERC" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] went to the headquarters in order to initiate the [[Bounty Hunter Wars]].<ref name="TMA" />
